country.evidence_quote: Nickelodeon, now in its 47th year, is the number-one entertainment brand for kids and the home of SpongeBob and PAW Patrol. It has built a diverse, global business by putting kids first in everything it does. The brand includes television programming and production in the United States and around the world, plus consumer products, digital, location-based experiences, publishing, and feature films. Nickelodeon is a division of Paramount, a Skydance Corporation.
